name: collapsable
label: Collapsible
description: Option to allow a user to hide the contextual sidebar.

name: defaultCollapsed
label: Initially Collapsed
description: Option to hide the contextual sidebar by default. A user can open the sidebar by selecting a tab. To enable this option, you must first select to make the sidebar collapsible.

name: position
label: Postion of toolbar
description: Postion of toolbar with resport to sidebar panels. Default value is 'right'.

name: hideLabel
label: Hide Toolbar Label
description: Option to hide toolbar button labels.
